Name: The Depths
Author: dogman463
Description:
[size=5][b]The Depths: Tempest, Tectonic & Inferno[/b][/size]
[i]300 new mine floors for late-game players who have run out of things to fight.[/i]

[size=4][b]What this mod adds[/b][/size]
Three new elemental mines below the Mines, each with 100 floors, its own enemies, its own elevator and a boss on floor 100.

[list]
[*][b]The Tempest Depths (Wind)[/b]: opened from Mines floor 120 once you own a Galaxy weapon. Boss: the Royal Serpent.[/*]
[*][b]The Tectonic Depths (Earth)[/b]: unlocked by beating the Royal Serpent. Tougher rock from floor 50. Boss: the Mountain Golem.[/*]
[*][b]The Inferno Depths (Lava)[/b]: unlocked by beating the Mountain Golem. Lava channels you cool with a watering can. Boss: the Caldera Beast.[/*]
[*][b]Another set of Depths (Secret): [/b]as something else to find. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]300 new floors[/*]
[*]34 enemy types plus elites: a vanilla-style mix of slimes, bats, crabs, golems, ghosts, skeletons, bugs, spiders, brutes, shamans and more, each recoloured for its element[/*]
[*]Signature monsters on the deep floors (from floor 41 and 61) with their own attacks: lightning, wind blades, ground slams, crystal shards, eruptions and a smoke-wraith that blinks next to you. Ground attacks glow before they land, so you can dodge them.[/*]
[*]Three boss fights with guardians; the giant golem bosses rise from a pile of rocks[/*]
[*]Hidden ladders like the vanilla Mines: break rocks to find the way down, plus rare infested floors[/*]
[*]Gentle death: you never lose items in the Depths, just a rescue fee (3k / 6k / 9k gold)[/*]
[*]Vanilla-style ladders and elevators every 5 floors (unlocked by actually reaching them), plus glowing witch-hut runes[/*]
[*]Multiplayer and split-screen support[/*]
[*]3 forges and 15 weapons (plus a few you'll have to find): Tempest, Tectonic and Inferno blades, gavels and daggers. They're full power in the Depths and still strong elsewhere (about 500 / 600 / 800 per hit).[/*]
[*]The Tectonic Pickaxe, a level-5 upgrade to the Iridium Pickaxe that breaks any Depths rock in one hit (keeps enchantments)[/*]
[*]25 new materials and consumables[/*]
[*]7 new machines that also work like their vanilla twins (Keg, Preserves Jar, Geode Crusher, Furnace, Crystalarium, Recycling Machine) at twice the speed and with no fuel: Inferno Keg, Tempest Press, Tectonic Crusher, Magma Furnace, Ember Duplicator, Basalt Recycler, Storm Lamp[/*]
[*]Animated volcano lava that blocks your way until you cool it with your watering can (or a tractor)[/*]
[*]Secrets. Some are easy to spot, some really aren't, and at least one is much bigger than the rest. No spoilers here.[/*]
[*]Full in-game settings with Generic Mod Config Menu: difficulty, enemy counts, rock toughness and hazards[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Progression[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Reach Mines floor 120 with a Galaxy weapon: the Wind rune awakens[/*]
[*]Defeat the Royal Serpent on Wind 100: the Earth rune joins it on floor 120[/*]
[*]Earth floor 50: Tectonic Pickaxe forge[/*]
[*]Defeat the Mountain Golem on Earth 100: the Inferno rune joins them[/*]
[*]Defeat the Caldera Beast on Inferno 100: Inferno weapon forge[/*]
[/list]Every boss floor has a rune back to Mines 120, and once its guardian falls, a rune straight on to the next element. Bosses return every day with their full rewards.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.0 or later[/*]
[*][i]Optional:[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Unzip into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder. You should get [b]TempestDepths_Code[/b] and [b]TempestDepths_Content[/b].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]
Before removing the mod, leave the Depths, sell or trash this mod's items and weapons, and remove its machines. Then delete both folders. Items left behind become Error Items.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer and split-screen supported.[/b] Every player keeps their own elevator stops and unlocks. To unlock the next region you must be in the boss fight. Everyone needs the mod installed.[/*]
[*]Does not change vanilla Mines or Skull Cavern floors.[/*]
[*]Not tested on Android.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Known issues[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]None known. Please report bugs with a SMAPI log link from [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url].[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]AI use[/b][/size]
This mod was made with the help of AI tools (ChatGPT for the first version, then Claude). The AI wrote most of the C# code, generated the floor maps and wrote much of the text, working from my designs, ideas and feedback. I decided what the mod should be, directed every feature, and playtested and tuned it.
Most of the art isn't stored in the mod at all: monsters, weapons, items and machines are recoloured at runtime from your own copy of the game's textures. The floor tiles are recoloured versions of a tile sheet made for the mod.

[size=4][b]Permissions[/b][/size]
Please don't re-upload this mod. Translations are welcome; contact me first.
